summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 7 features. All 11 backend tests passed (2 skipped due to no test data). All frontend features verified working correctly. Developer role can access Settings page without 'Acceso denegado' error.

developer_role_settings_access.details: GET /api/users works with developer role - no 'Acceso denegado' error. Settings page loads correctly for developer role.

settings_users_search.details: Users tab has search bar (data-testid='search-users-input') that filters by name/email

settings_clients_crud.details: Clients tab has search bar, edit button, delete button. PUT /api/clients/{id} and DELETE /api/clients/{id} work correctly.

settings_providers_crud.details: Providers tab has search bar, edit button, delete button. PUT /api/providers/{id} and DELETE /api/providers/{id} work correctly.

dashboard_5_kpi_cards.details: Dashboard shows 5 KPI cards: Rutas activas, Paquetes entregados, Incidencias abiertas, Rutas cerradas, Calidad de soporte

dashboard_package_search.details: Dashboard has package search bar (data-testid='package-search-input') that searches by order_reference_id. GET /api/packages/search?q=test returns matching packages.

cleanup_endpoint.details: POST /api/cleanup/routes-packages clears journeys, packages, incidents. Returns deleted counts.

start_route_checklist_order.details: Checklist has 9 items in chronological order: 1) CEDIS arrival, 2) CEDIS pass, 3) Cosmo route, 4) Packages scanned, 5) Retry registered, 6) WhatsApp, 7) Odometer photo (opcional), 8) CEDIS screenshot (opcional), 9) Zone confirmed

start_route_optional_items.details: Items 7 (odometer_photo) and 8 (cedis_screenshot) show '(opcional)' label in grey text

start_route_photo_optional.details: Photo upload shows '(opcional)' label and help text: 'Solo si genera valor adicional — las evidencias en WhatsApp y Cosmo son el respaldo principal.'

start_route_route_type.details: Start Route form has route_type selector (CDMX/Foránea) with conditional city/max_packages fields when Foránea is selected

evidence_scoring_failed.details: Evidence scoring for failed packages: proof>=1 gives 100, proof==0 gives 0. No incident check used for scoring (incident_registered stored but not used).

cleanup_button_settings.details: Cleanup button 'Limpiar rutas y pedidos' visible in Settings page header for coordinator/developer roles

seed_data_creation: Created test journey 7c1290cd-1f51-4470-bb34-7da120144010 for UI testing (not deleted - no DELETE endpoint for journeys)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 features fully tested. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_features.py cover: developer role access to /api/users, clients CRUD (PUT/DELETE), providers CRUD (PUT/DELETE), package search, cleanup endpoint, reports schema, dashboard stats with quality KPI. Frontend verified: Settings page loads for developer role with search bars in all tabs (Users/Clients/Providers), edit/delete buttons for clients and providers, cleanup button visible. Dashboard shows 5 KPI cards including 'Calidad de soporte' and package search bar. Start Route form has route_type selector and checklist in chronological order with items 7-8 marked as (opcional). Evidence scoring for failed packages uses proof_count only (no incident check).
